reviews.review_msg: I thought this semester Reid would be improved, but he has gotten worse and worse with each passing day. Rushes through lecture slides, skips content, creates exam questions that are not from the lectures! Hard to communicate with him about course content since he always avoids anyone but the students he likes. 0/5 if there was the option for that.

Completely disappears during office hours and will never provide any help. Reid's exams are also designed to fail you, studying for weeks before the exam is of no use because Reid puts questions that he never taught. Unfortunate that Reid teaches all the mandatory classes because there is no way to get anything better than a C-.

Great lecturer! Reid often teaches challenging courses, but includes review so students can remember prerequisite knowledge. Also great at breaking down complex topics into understandable information. Highly recommend taking his courses.
